The page is two worked-example boxes (Example 11.1, Example 11.2) followed by section 11.8. Each box's prose is kept as box blocks and the display maths inside them is split out as needs_special equation blocks (n=2 the photon-energy calculation, n=4 the N = P/E fraction, n=6 the threshold-frequency fraction chain, n=8 the eV0 = hn – f0 = hc/l – f0 chain down to "= 454 nm"); the text layer renders those piles as broken vertical fragments (stray exponents, numerators and denominators on separate lines), which is why they go to the special transcriber. The vertical side tabs " EXAMPLE 11.1" and " EXAMPLE 11.2" are listed as removed furniture. Text-layer notation losses vs image: "n"/"n0" are Greek nu, "f0"/"f 0" are Greek phi subscript 0, "l" is Greek lambda, "´" stands for the multiplication sign, and exponents are flattened ("10–34" is 10 to the power minus 34, "1014" is 10 to the power 14, "1015" is 10 to the power 15).
